Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.controller.adapter

Class KeyRotationAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.controller.adapter.KeyRotationAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
EventListener, javafx.event.EventHandler<javafx.scene.input.KeyEvent>
public class KeyRotationAdapter extends Object implements javafx.event.EventHandler<javafx.scene.input.KeyEvent>
Adapter responsible for handling keyboard events related to ship rotation. This class listens for JavaFX key events and delegates rotation requests to a RotationListener when the corresponding key is pressed. Currently, the rotation action is triggered by the Space key.

      public void handle(javafx.scene.input.KeyEvent event)
      Handles keyboard events generated by JavaFX. If the Space key is pressed, a rotation request is sent to the associated RotationListener and the event is consumed to prevent further propagation.
